mentions.name: Captrice
mentions.description: A guitar practice web app that helps players build speed and consistency of practice, featuring an interactive metronome tutorial for onboarding beginners. It is currently a local-only static web app with no backend server, and device sync functionality is planned.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my guitar practice app, Captrice[1]. Last week, I added an interactive metronome tutorial[2] in the app to help onboard beginners (quite a challenge). This week I'm planning to implement the long pending "device sync" functionality - currently it's a local-only webapp (it's all static pages; no backend server).
mentions.author: naiquevin
